text: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens and in good health.Applicants' educational qualifications and age requirements: For those pursuing a bachelor's degree, they must have completed high school or equivalent educational courses and be no older than 25 years old. Those who come to China to pursue a master's degree must have a bachelor's degree and be no more than 35 years old.Those who come to China to pursue a doctoral degree must have a master's degree and be no older than 40 years old.
